name: Camex Limited
about: Camex Limited manufactures, imports, exports, and trades in dyes, chemicals and intermediates, fiber glasses, metals, coal minerals, and others in India and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Dyes & Chemicals and Fiber Glass. It offers reactive, acid, direct dyes; textile auxiliaries and specialty chemicals; plastic chemicals; and fiberglass products. Camex Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
